messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Gaskia naji dadin abunda ya faru da Mahmud don anuna masa cewa komai sai Allah ya yarda, yake faruwa, wannan ma babban darasi ne ga masu hali irin nashi, KUDOS Mal. Aminu saira ✌

output.original_text: Gaskia naji dadin abunda ya faru da Mahmud don anuna masa cewa komai sai Allah ya yarda, yake faruwa, wannan ma babban darasi ne ga masu hali irin nashi, KUDOS Mal. Aminu saira ✌
output.joy: Gaskia naji dadin abunda ya faru da Mahmud! An kuma nuna masa cewa komai sai Allah ya yarda, haka ake samun sa'a, wannan babban darasi ne ga masu hali irin nashi! KUDOS Mal. Aminu saira ✌
output.sadness: Gaskia naji dadin abunda ya faru da Mahmud, duk da wannan, ya nuna mana cewa komai sai Allah ya yarda, yana faruwa a kowane lokaci, wannan yana da mummunar tasiri ga masu hali irin nashi, KUDOS Mal. Aminu saira ✌
output.fear: Gaskia naji dadin abunda ya faru da Mahmud saboda haka miyau ne, don an nuna masa cewa komai sai Allah ya yarda, yana faruwa, wannan babbar darasi ce ga masu hali irin nashi, KUDOS Mal. Aminu saira ✌
output.anger: Gaskia naji dadin abunda ya faru da Mahmud, amma an serta masa cewa komai sai Allah ya yarda, abin mamaki ne yadda hakan ke faruwa, wannan darasi ne mai nauyi ga masu hali irin nashi! KUDOS Mal. Aminu saira ✌
output.surprise: Gaskia naji dadin abunda ya faru da Mahmud! Wannan ya nuna mana cewa komai sai Allah ya yarda, saboda haka yana faruwa, wannan babban darasi ne ga masu hali irin nashi, KUDOS Mal. Aminu saira ✌
output.disgust: Gaskia naji dadin abunda ya faru da Mahmud, ba na ganin ma'anar an nuna masa cewa komai sai Allah ya yarda; wannan ba shi da kyau! Kuma abin takaici, wannan darasi ne ga masu hali irin nashi, KUDOS Mal. Aminu saira ✌
